in_sanskrit.name: सौदामिनी
in_sanskrit.meaning: दामनी दानवत्वे विवादिनी (one who causes disputes among demons)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who causes disputes among demons (dāmāni dānava-tvā eva vivādinī). This name is mentioned in the Mahabharata.

in_hindi.name: सौदामिनी
in_hindi.meaning: साम Daam (dispute, quarrel) + मिनी (one who causes)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who causes disputes or quarrels (sāma daam + minī).

in_tamil.name: சௌதாமினி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who causes disputes or quarrels (cōtam ini).

in_telugu.name: సౌదామిని
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who causes disputes or quarrels (sōdhaṃ ini).

in_marathi.name: Saudamini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saudamini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Saudamini represents the power of victory and the courage to overcome adversity. She is a symbol of strength and protection, and her name is often invoked during times of conflict or struggle.
